title.narrative: Catalysing the low carbon transition and electric mobility development in Costa Rica through National Bank of Costa Rica

description.narrative: The Project will support Banco Nacional de Costa Rica (BNCR) in elaborating a comprehensive approach to address climate issues (i) in its strategy and internal organization, and (ii) in its operational activities, with a view to catalysing climate finance in Costa Rica.
